title: OnePlus N6X to Pack Snapdragon 695 5G with Bigger Battery
summary: OnePlus plans to launch the N6X on July 31, 2026. Leaks and confirmations indicate a return to legacy hardware like a 3.5mm jack and an LCD panel, while adding a large 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, 5G support and OxygenOS. Expected chipset is the Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G with 4GB/6GB RAM options and 128GB–256GB storage. Two colours: Burgundy Red and Iced Blue.

OnePlus is gearing up to launch its next N6X smartphone on July 31, 2026. Ahead of the launch, we have some fresh leaks suggesting OnePlus will take a complete U-turn by bringing back hardware specifications from the past, including a 3.5 mm jack and an LCD panel. It will still retain the latest larger silicon-carbon battery, 5G connectivity, and Oxygen OS software. OnePlus seems to be taking a more careful approach amid the memory price hike.

If you are looking to upgrade to a budget-friendly smartphone, we have you covered with everything we know so far about the OnePlus N6X.

OnePlus India has confirmed some specifications, including colour, battery life, and design. TheOnePlus N6Xwill feature an older design inspired by the OnePlus Nord 5phone.

It has a pill-shaped camera housed vertically on the top-left side, a polycarbonate back, a plastic chassis, and a flat front screen.

We also have confirmation that the phone will have a bigger 7,000mAh battery, promising up to 2.5 days of battery life.

The phone will come in two colour options: the all-new Burgundy Red and Iced Blue.

Also Read:OnePlus Shuts Down Internationally, What Went Wrong

As OnePlus prepares to launch its next budget-friendly phone, new leaks reveal a complete U-turn in hardware specifications.

OnePlus is bringing back the long-ditched 3.5mm jack and switching from an AMOLED panel to an LCD.

It still retains a bigger battery and 5G connectivity, making it a worthwhile choice for the price.

Leaks from credible sources claim the phone will be positioned just below the previously launched N6.

Compared to the N6, the N6X will have trimmed-down specifications. Rumours say it will feature an HD+ flat panel on the front, with mostly 120Hz refresh-rate support and a peak brightness of 3,000 nits.

The Dimensity 6360 Apex powers the previously launched N6.

For the N6X, we expect OnePlus to use a Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G chipset, offering a decent balance of performance, efficiency, and 5G connectivity.

We expect the chipset to come with two RAM variants: 4GB and 6GB. Storage will start at 128GB and go up to 256GB.

Also Read:OnePlus 16, OPPO Find X10 Ultra India Launch Could Cancel

According to leaks, the phone will be positioned just below the previously launchedN6and is likely to be priced below Rs 20,000.

We are a few days away from the official launch of the OnePlus N6X. We will update you with more news soon. Are you excited for the new OnePlus N6X?

OnePlus India has confirmed it will launch the OnePlus N6X phone on July 31, 2026.

According to recent reports, the OnePlus N6 will be powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G chipset. However, this detail is not confirmed yet.

OnePlus has officially confirmed the phone will be powered by the latest 7,000mAh Silicon-carbon (Si-C) battery, promising up to 2.5 days of battery life.

Yes, OnePlus N6X will get a dedicated 3.5mm jack.

If you're looking for a smartphone with a large battery, OxygenOS, and features like a headphone jack, the OnePlus N6X could be worth waiting for.

## Overview

As OnePlus gears up to launch its N6X smartphone, we have fresh details about the specifications. OnePlus confirmed that the phone will have a larger battery and come in two colours. Apart from this confirmed update, leaks suggest the phone will be powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G chipset. Here is everything we know so far:

## Key confirmed details

* Launch date: July 31, 2026 (OnePlus India confirmed)
* Battery: 7,000mAh Silicon-carbon (Si-C) battery, promising up to 2.5 days of battery life
* Colours: Burgundy Red and Iced Blue
* Software: OxygenOS
* Headphone jack: Dedicated 3.5mm jack confirmed

Also Read: OnePlus Shuts Down Internationally, What Went Wrong

## Design and build

The OnePlus N6X will feature an older design inspired by the OnePlus Nord 5 phone. Key design details:

* Pill-shaped camera module housed vertically on the top-left side
* Polycarbonate back
* Plastic chassis
* Flat front screen

## Display and performance (leaks)

* Screen: Expected HD+ flat panel, switching from AMOLED to LCD
* Refresh rate: Mostly 120Hz support claimed
* Peak brightness: Up to 3,000 nits (rumoured)
* Chipset: Leaks suggest the Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G for a balance of performance and efficiency (not officially confirmed)
* RAM options: Expected 4GB and 6GB
* Storage: 128GB and 256GB options expected

The previously launched N6 was powered by the Dimensity 6360 Apex. The N6X is reportedly positioned just below the N6 with trimmed-down specifications.

Also Read: OnePlus 16, OPPO Find X10 Ultra India Launch Could Cancel

## Battery and connectivity

OnePlus has officially confirmed the latest 7,000mAh Si-C battery with up to 2.5 days of battery life. The N6X will retain 5G connectivity despite the shift to more budget-friendly hardware choices.

## Positioning and price (leaks)

* Positioned below the OnePlus N6
* Likely to be priced below Rs 20,000

If you’re looking for a smartphone with a large battery, OxygenOS, and features like a headphone jack, the OnePlus N6X could be worth waiting for.
